title: Holes
author: Louis Sachar
summary: Stanley Yelnats is sent to Camp Green Lake, a dry lakebed in Texas where boys dig a hole every day. As he digs, three storylines from different eras slowly connect, along with a family curse.
readIf: you enjoy a clever, funny story that quietly ties together past and present.
skipIf: you want a lot of depth in characters or emotional tangle, because it is short and plot-driven.

pairings.reason: Another short, fast, outdoors survival story for young readers.
A funnier, more fantastical adventure about a boy who finds out the world is bigger than he knew.
